system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — Rowan Companies plc realized record after combination with Ensco, ~3–5-year horizon

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. Because the company was acquired and
> deregistered at closing, there is no post-closing public 10-K under its own SEC
> registrant; the realized record is assessed through its deregistration filing and a
> check of the surviving combined registrant's subsequent public filings for any
> separate disclosure of the acquired business. This sub-dossier contains no
> information about how the transaction was structured at closing.

## Public-reporting status after the transaction
- Rowan ordinary shares ceased trading on the NYSE before the market opened on the transaction's closing date (April 11, 2019), and Rowan requested that the NYSE file a Form 25 notification to remove its shares from listing and deregister them under Exchange Act Section 12(b). [SRC: SEC accession 0001144204-19-019311, Form 8-K]
- Rowan filed a Form 15-12B on April 22, 2019 to deregister its ordinary shares under Exchange Act Section 12(g) and suspend its reporting obligations under Sections 13(a) and 15(d). [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-19-022840, Form 15-12B]
- No Form 10-K, 10-Q, or 8-K has been filed under Rowan's own SEC registrant (CIK 0000085408) since its April 11, 2019 closing-related Form 8-K; Rowan's last periodic report filed as an independent registrant was its Form 10-K for fiscal year 2018, filed February 27, 2019. [SRC: SEC EDGAR filing history for CIK 0000085408, accessions 0000085408-19-000010, 0001144204-19-019311, and 0001104659-19-022840]

## Whether the surviving combined registrant separately discloses the acquired business
- As a result of the transaction, Rowan became an indirect, wholly-owned subsidiary of the combined company, the surviving public registrant (CIK 0000314808, formerly Ensco plc). [SRC: SEC accession 0001144204-19-019311, Form 8-K]
- That registrant's later Form 10-K for fiscal year 2021 (filed February 22, 2022) reports its offshore-drilling rig fleet in two operating categories, "Floaters" and "Jackups," organized by rig type; it does not present a separate segment, financial, or operating disclosure attributable specifically to the legacy Rowan business. [SRC: SEC accession 0000314808-22-000011, Form 10-K for fiscal year 2021]
- The only "legacy Rowan" references identified in that filing concern the consolidation of legacy Rowan employee retirement and savings plans into combined-entity benefit plans, not a separately disclosed business or financial trajectory for the acquired operations. [SRC: SEC accession 0000314808-22-000011, Form 10-K for fiscal year 2021]

## Outcome summary and no-record note (§4)
- Because Rowan's shares stopped trading and the company deregistered from SEC reporting within about two weeks of the transaction's closing, and because the surviving combined registrant's subsequent public filings report on a consolidated basis with no segment or comparable disclosure specific to the legacy Rowan business, there is no public 3–5-year outcome record specific to the acquired business as a distinct entity. Consistent with the no-record rule, the post-transaction trajectory of the acquired business is coded uncertain rather than inferred from the combined registrant's consolidated results. [SRC: SEC accession 0001104659-19-022840, Form 15-12B; SEC accession 0000314808-22-000011, Form 10-K for fiscal year 2021]

[SLICE END]
